author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
> That is interesting. My former assitant left this note in the code:
> 
> > c Senior Housing Credit is not coded because
> > c most elderly will not be eligible according to this:.
> > c https://tax.colorado.gov/income-qualified-senior-housing-income-tax-credit
> 
> I have no opinion on this, but I thought you should have a look at the that URL before I change anything here. I found this:
> 
> https://www.douglas.co.us/documents/hb24-1052-senior-housing-income-tax-credit.pdf/
> 
> which is more optimistic.

It appears that filers are ineligible if they receive the senior property tax exemption. We currently don't include this in our model, I will add a dependency in the future but for now I would provide the credit.
